latestRelease.name: BertoPad Firmware v4.13.0 (Flagship Edition)
latestRelease.body: Flagship v4.13.0: Full Studio Web App integration, instant Web Serial macro cancellation (/api/macro/cancel), direct Wi-Fi OTA update engine (/api/ota/start), display brightness controls (MEDIA:BRIGHT_UP/DOWN), full extended keyboard key library, dual rotary encoder acceleration, and watchdog protection.

recentReleases.name: BertoPad Firmware v4.12.1
